|strategy=By [mailto:jediknight@decipher.com Jedi Knight]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/light/small/yottsorren.html</ref>

A Light Side 2/2 alien that brings a few good elements to the Light Side's fight against the Imperial Armored Division!

First point of note is that he is a smuggler. This means an option for your [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough{{!}}Watch Your Step]] deck. What's more, he's a pilot, capable of [[Kessel]] Running if [[Dash]] is on holidays. There are a few other related benefits for smugglers such as cheap deploy to [[Kashyyyk]], or meeting a requirement in your Profit deck so you can play [[Jabba]]'s Palace sabacc! Beware a [[Death Mark]], though.

His text provides him with a great all-round ability against opponent's vehicular threats. Power -2 against combat vehicles at same site (note that Yotts does not have to be present, so feel free to hide him inside a vehicle of your own!), and a once-per-game grab of [[Free Ride]] (steal a vehicle) and/or [[Mechanical Failure]] ([[Lateral Damage]] a vehicle!). If you are playing either of these cards, Yotts may beg for consideration!
